name: Performance Monitoring Alert
xql_query:
preset = metrics_view
| alter unique_id = concat(_collector_id, _collector_ip, _collector_name, _collector_type, _final_reporting_device_ip, _final_reporting_device_name, _broker_device_id, _vendor, _product)
| comp avg(total_event_rate) as total_event_rate_avg by unique_id
// Feeds averaging under 0.05 events/s (~4,300/day) are trickles: one quiet window is "-50%".
| filter total_event_rate_avg >= 0.05
| join conflict_strategy = both (
    preset = metrics_view
    | filter timestamp_diff(current_time(), _time, "minute") <= 30
    | alter unique_id = concat(_collector_id, _collector_ip, _collector_name, _collector_type, _final_reporting_device_ip, _final_reporting_device_name, _broker_device_id, _vendor, _product)
    | comp avg(total_event_rate) as total_event_rate, max(_time) as last_sample by unique_id) as recent
  recent.unique_id = unique_id
| filter total_event_rate < multiply(total_event_rate_avg, 0.5)
| fields unique_id, total_event_rate_avg, total_event_rate, last_sample
description: Data feed health: a source averaging at least 0.05 events/s over 7 days has run below half that rate for the last 30 minutes. One issue per source per 12 hours.
